init root 0x200000
create-domain root app1 0b0011 GET,ATTEST,SWITCH
create-domain root app2 0b1100 GET,ATTEST,SWITCH
carve r0 app1_mem 0x80000 0x40000 RWX
carve r0 app2_mem 0x100000 0x40000 RWX
send app1_mem app1
send app2_mem app2
seal app1
seal app2
list
switch app1 0 0
switch app1 1 1
switch app2 2 0
switch app2 3 1
list
